jobs.title: Director of Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
### **About Forma.ai:**



Forma.ai is a Series B startup that's revolutionizing how sales compensation is designed, managed and optimized. We handle billions in annual managed commissions for market leaders like Edmentum, Stryker, and Autodesk.



Our growth has been fuelled by our passion for fundamentally changing and shaping how companies use sales intelligence to drive business strategy.



We're welcoming equally driven individuals who are excited about creating something big!

**DIRECTOR OF STRATEGIC FINANCE**  

Strategic FP\&A, AI Automation, \& Executive\-Level Storytelling


**ABOUT THE ROLE:**



We are looking for an exceptional, hands\-on Director of Strategic Finance to act as the strategic right\-hand lead to our VP of Finance. Operating alongside our Controller (who leads accounting close, statutory compliance, tax, and ERP administration), you will own our forward\-looking financial strategy. You will lead our corporate modelling, deploy AI and modern automation workflows across Finance and RevOps, execute on M\&A and capital markets transactions, and use generative AI or AI applications to build out high\-performance analytics frameworks as the company scales.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO (KEY RESPONSIBILITIES):**  

  

1\. Hands\-On Strategic FP\&A \& Corporate Modeling  

* Corporate Financial Architecture: Build and maintain our dynamic 3\-statement models, weekly/monthly/quarterly operating plans, revenue forecasting, multi\-year operating forecasts, and scenario analyses from the ground up without relying on junior analysts.
* Executive \& Board Presentation: Spearhead the quantitative financial narrative, analysis, and materials for Board of Directors meetings, executive quarterly reviews, and investor reporting.
* Corporate Planning: Lead the annual budgeting process by working with the executive team to develop an annual plan with near real\-time reporting on plan progress.
* Future Team Foundation: Establish rigorous modeling standards and analytical infrastructure today, with the mandate to hire, mentor, and build out an FP\&A and FinOps team over the next 1–2 years.


2\. Financial Engineering \& AI Workflow Automation  

* AI Agent \& Workflow Deployment: Identify manual bottlenecks across billing, contract parsing, data extraction, and commercial operations; build and deploy LLM workflows, custom prompts, and automated scripts.
* Data Pipeline \& Systems Integration: Architect and optimize data flows connecting CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot), CPQ, Billing, and ERP systems to automate revenue operations and eliminate reconciliation friction.
* Modern Automation Tooling: Use tools like Python, SQL, Zapier/Make, and API integrations to establish self\-sustaining, real\-time reporting layers.
* AI Analytics \& Insights: Leverage AI to drive deeper analysis and insights throughout the organization (i.e. QBR's, MMR's, BvA's)


3\. RevOps \& Commercial Structuring  

* GTM Engine Analytics: Partner with RevOps to track and analyze sales capacity, pipeline velocity, CAC/LTV dynamics, and retention cohorts.
* Deal Structuring \& Deal Desk: Serve as the primary strategic finance partner to Sales and RevOps on deal structuring, pricing models, margin analysis, discounting schedules, and commercial contract terms.


4\. **M\&A / Capital Markets Execution \& Compensation Modelling**  

* Transaction \& Valuation Execution: Own the operational execution for M\&A / capital market transactions, including due diligence financial modelling, virtual data room (VDR) setup, and cap table administration
* Compensation Architecture: Model and maintain corporate compensation bands, incentive structures, and equity option pool dilution economics.
  

**WHO YOU ARE (QUALIFICATIONS):**


* 7–10\+ years in Strategic Finance, FP\&A, BizOps, or Investment Banking / Management Consulting followed by high\-growth B2B SaaS operational experience. Strong business acumen with a high intellectual curiosity.
* **FP\&A Mastery:** Spreadsheet wizard with demonstrated mastery of complex revenue modelling, 3\-statement modelling, operational modelling, SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, GRR, CAC payback), and executive\-level financial storytelling.
* **Engineering \& AI Mindset:** Practical experience architecting the finance tech stack and working with data, deploying AI/LLM tools, automation platforms (Python, SQL, Zapier/Make), and SaaS toolchains (Salesforce, Stripe/Chargebee, NetSuite) to eliminate manual workflows.
* **Commercial Depth:** Proven deal desk and commercial contract experience, with a solid grasp of pricing models, billing schedules, and equity compensation economics.
* **Autonomy \& Drive:** High\-autonomy builder who thrives with ambiguity and enjoys executing hands\-on work from scratch with the leadership aptitude to manage direct reports as the team grows.

 **WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT:**  

  

You won't be managing month\-end reconciliations, audits, tax filings, or HR administration—our Controller leads those domains with excellence. You are joining to be an operational architect and strategic partner: designing intelligent financial infrastructure, building board\-level models, and leveraging AI to scale our operational engine.

  

**ADDITIONAL JOB INFO:**


* This position is for an existing vacancy
* Salary range: 150\-180K

**What you can expect from us**
-------------------------------


**Meaningful compensation.** In addition to your base salary, you'll join our employee stock ownership plan to further recognize your contributions to Forma.ai's success.


**Healthcare coverage.** We have a full benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, and a paid parental leave program.

jobs.title: Transformation Consulting Managing Director
jobs.description:
**Req ID:** 393227
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Transformation Consulting Managing Director to join our team in Toronto, Ontario (CA\-ON), Canada (CA).
  
  

The Sr Infrastructure Transformation and Consulting Director will be responsible for designing, guiding, and overseeing NTT DATA North America’s overall technology infrastructure with a primary focus on Infrastructure Transformation. This role will align IT strategy with business goals by assessing current\-state environments, identifying modernization opportunities, and creating a blueprint for future technology development, including standards, policies, and architecture frameworks to support efficient, secure, scalable, and transformation\-ready operations across the enterprise; essentially acting as a bridge between business needs and technical implementation.
  
  

* This position is remote, however will require some travel to the client site.


**Key responsibilities:**  

**IT Strategic planning:**  

Develop and maintain the enterprise architecture roadmap, aligning IT strategy with business objectives for NTT DATA, Merger and Acquisition integrations, and enterprise\-wide Infrastructure Transformation initiatives.
  
  

**Architecture design:**  

Design and document the overall system architecture, including application, data, infrastructure, cloud, security, and transformation components to support modernization and scalable enterprise operations.
  
  

**Technology evaluation:**  

Research and evaluate new technologies, platforms, and infrastructure modernization approaches to identify opportunities for transformation, operational improvement, and long\-term scalability.
  
  

**Standards and governance:**  

Establish and enforce architectural standards, guidelines, and governance processes to ensure consistency and compliance
  
  

**Collaboration:**  

Work with various stakeholders including business leaders, global EAs, project teams, and technical teams to understand requirements and translate them into architectural solutions.
  
  

**Cost optimization:**  

Analyze and optimize IT spending by identifying potential cost savings through architectural improvements.
  
  

**Risk management:**  

Identify and mitigate potential risks associated with technology architecture.
  
  

**Communication and documentation:**  

Clearly communicate architectural concepts and decisions to technical and non\-technical audiences through documentation and presentations.
  
  

Basic Requirements
  
  

* 11\+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, infrastructure transformation, cloud computing, Generative AI, LLMs, databases, networking, security, and application development, with a deep understanding of how these technologies support business and modernization objectives.


Additional Preferences
  
  

**Leadership skills:**  

Minimum of 11\+ years of experience influencing and guiding cross\-functional teams toward implementing an enterprise architecture vision, with demonstrated ability to lead infrastructure transformation and modernization efforts.
  
  

**Business acumen:**  

Ability to understand business needs and translate them into technical requirements.
  
  

**Communication skills:**  

Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively collaborate with diverse stakeholders.
  
  

**Analytical skills:**  

Ability to analyze complex systems, identify potential issues, and propose solutions.
  
  

NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for Canada\-based positions. The starting pay range for this role is $187,192 \- $311,988 CAD. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications. This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation based on individual and/or company performance. If the position offered is temporary, the position will not be eligible for incentive compensation.
  
  

This position is eligible for the Company’s comprehensive benefits program in Canada, including customizable health and dental coverage with telemedicine, wellness credits, and gym discounts. Employees receive income protection through life, disability, and optional insurance plans, plus access to a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program. Additional perks include retirement savings, a remote work allowance for eligible employees, and various discounts and travel insurance.
  
  

About NTT DATA
  
  

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in\-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible

jobs.title: Senior Director, Group Product Owner - Enterprise Governance, Risk & Compliance (eGRC)
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship\-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.


At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.


To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com


**What you'll be doing**

  

As Senior Director, Group Product Owner – Enterprise Governance, Risk \& Compliance (eGRC), you'll shape how CIBC identifies, manages, and responds to operational risk. You will shift our programs from manual, periodic, judgment\-based activities to connected, AI\-enabled capabilities that anticipate risk, automate routine work, and focus people on the decisions that matter most.


You will lead CIBC's eGRC ecosystem, including the Operational Risk System (ORS) and enterprise operational risk data governance. With a mandate to rethink, not simply maintain, you'll define the target operating model, investment priorities, and product roadmap; simplify and automate risk work with our program team; and use connected data, advanced analytics, generative and agentic AI, and continuous monitoring to surface emerging risk and improve decisions. You will ensure these capabilities are deployed responsibly through strong data, model, security, privacy, control, and human\-in\-the\-loop practices.

  

  

*At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You'll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you'll spend 1\-3 days per week on\-site, while other days will be remote.*

  

**How you'll succeed**

  

* **Enterprise Strategy and Transformation** \- Define the ambition, target operating model, and multi\-year roadmap for CIBC's eGRC ecosystem. Align partners and investment to the highest risk and regulatory priorities, making bold, evidence\-based choices that create lasting value.
* **Enterprise Product Leadership** \- Set priorities from discovery through adoption and continuous improvement. Establish disciplined governance, translate strategy into a clear roadmap, and use customer, risk, operational, and financial insight to accelerate outcomes and demonstrate value.
* **Reimagining Operational Risk Programs** \- Redesign core programs, including risk and control assessments, control management, issues, incidents, losses, scenarios, regulatory change, and reporting. Replace fragmented manual processes with simpler, automated, connected experiences that improve coverage, reduce administration, and focus attention on the highest\-risk exposures and actions.
* **AI, Automation and Insight\-Driven Risk** \- Make operational risk data a trusted enterprise asset across eGRC and ORS. Set standards for ownership, quality, lineage, access, retention, and traceability; automate workflows, evidence gathering, monitoring, and reporting; and apply analytics and responsible AI to detect patterns, anticipate risk, and recommend action. Measure success through stronger outcomes, earlier intervention, better user experience, and capacity shifted from administration to judgment.
* **Executive Governance and Regulatory Confidence** \- Establish clear decision rights, accountability, and portfolio oversight. Influence senior forums with concise, forward\-looking recommendations, and keep the ecosystem resilient and ready for regulatory and audit scrutiny.
* **Enterprise Influence and Coalition Building** \- Unite Business, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, Resilience, Third\-Party, Technology, Data, and Architecture around a shared vision. Resolve trade\-offs and build the executive sponsorship and cross\-functional ownership needed for enterprise change.
* Investment, Delivery and Strategic Partnerships \- Turn ambition into an executable portfolio by aligning funding, capacity, sequencing, and risk to the highest\-value outcomes. Drive performance, innovation, and measurable value while keeping eGRC and ORS stable, secure, and fit for purpose.
* **Leadership and Capability Building** \- Build a high\-performing team with the product, risk, data, and transformation capabilities to lead at enterprise scale. Create clarity, empower decisions, and foster curiosity, courage, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. Oversee the eGRC helpdesk to maintain responsive support and turn recurring pain points into improvements.
  

  

**Who you are**

  

* **You're an enterprise transformation leader** with 10\+ years of progressive leadership across risk, compliance, controls, technology, product, or related disciplines, and a record of delivering complex change in a regulated organization.
* **You bring deep operational risk judgment** . You understand how frameworks, assessments, controls, issues, losses, data, and regulatory expectations connect, and translate that expertise into practical choices without unnecessary complexity.
* **You champion trusted data and high\-performing partnerships** . You have established data ownership, standards, quality, lineage, and remediation practices, and can challenge and inspire strategic technology vendors to improve performance, innovation, risk management, and value.
* **You're a visionary** , customer\-focused product leader who reimagines risk programs through AI, automation, data, and human\-centred design. You turn complex user, business, and regulatory needs into a clear roadmap and align stakeholders around measurable outcomes.
* **You have a record of delivering transformation at scale** , leading multi\-year initiatives from business case and design through implementation, integration, operating model change, adoption, and continuous improvement, with measurable results.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**



SickKids Foundation, with over 50 years of philanthropic impact is Canada's largest charitable funder of child health research, learning and care, raising over $200 million last year. As a national charity, SickKids Foundation invests in national and international initiatives to benefit children in Canada and around the world. As the fundraising partner to The Hospital for Sick Children (SickKids), we are aligned in supporting Precision Child Health (PCH), the future of tailoring medicine to each child's unique traits so SickKids can diagnose faster, treat smarter, and predict better.



We are driven by our core values of integrity, collaboration, excellence, innovation, and inclusion, with goals of delivering a superior donor experience, investing in our people and culture, driving innovative and sustainable fundraising, and disrupting the market through data and technology.



SickKids Foundation is committed to an inclusive culture by embedding equity, diversity and inclusion in our policies, practices, and behaviours. We aim to build awareness and skills in this area, both internally and with our partners. Our commitment extends to creating a safe, positive work environment. For details on our Equity, Diversity \& Inclusion commitment, please click here. (https://www.sickkidsfoundation.com/aboutus/equitydiversityandinclusion)



We’re committed to attracting and retaining passionate individuals to help create a healthier future. That’s why SickKids Foundation is looking for a new Associate Director, Data Engineer.


**Description of the Position**



Reporting to the Director, Data Science \& Engineering, the Associate Director, Data Engineer designs, builds, and operates enterprise\-grade data platforms that deliver trusted, well\-governed data across SickKids Foundation. The role will help establish and evolve a production\-grade cloud platform using medallion architecture principles, with a focus on reliability, data quality, cost efficiency, and scalable delivery.



As a senior hands\-on technical contributor, you will set engineering standards, support platform incident response, enable self\-serve analytics and AI\-powered data products, and provide specialized technical guidance to data and analytics partners across the Foundation.


**You will**


* Design, build, and operate enterprise\-grade data engineering platforms using modern cloud technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks, aligned to bronze, silver, and gold medallion architecture principles.
* Build and maintain robust, idempotent ETL/ELT pipelines with embedded validation, data quality checks, clear lineage, and repeatable delivery workflows.
* Design data models and semantic layers that make trusted data accessible for analytics, reporting, and self\-serve business intelligence.
* Establish platform observability through query profiling, cost attribution, utilization metrics, alerting, and SLO/SLA monitoring; lead day\-to\-day response to data availability and performance incidents.
* Define and enforce coding standards, CI/CD patterns, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code practices to support consistent, secure, and scalable platform deployment.
* Partner with business stakeholders, Data \& Analytics, IT/Infrastructure, and Security teams to translate requirements into reliable platform capabilities and support appropriate access, governance, and compliance.
* Enable AI and advanced analytics use cases, including natural\-language querying and AI\-powered data products, by partnering with stakeholders to identify and deliver high\-value opportunities.
* Stay current with developments in cloud data platforms, AI, and emerging engineering practices, bringing relevant advancements into the platform roadmap and providing technical guidance to analysts, BI developers, and engineering partners.


**Qualifications**



While we know that for any job posting no one candidate will possess the qualifications being sought in equal measure, below is an outline of the qualifications we believe are important for a candidate to bring to the position or for the successful candidate to develop while in the role:


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\-7 years of hands\-on data engineering or platform engineering experience, ideally spanning the full lifecycle of architecting, building, and operating production data platforms.
* Deep technical expertise with modern cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, or Databricks and strong knowledge of medallion/lakehouse architecture.
* Strong data modelling and database design skills for analytics and business consumption, including dimensional modelling and semantic layers for self\-serve BI.
* Hands\-on experience developing production\-grade ETL/ELT pipelines and working with data quality, governance, CI/CD, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code practices.
* Experience establishing observability, performance monitoring, reliability standards, and incident\-response practices in production data environments.
* Working knowledge of AI and advanced analytics tooling, including approaches that support natural\-language querying and AI\-powered data products.
* Strong technical judgment, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non\-technical stakeholder groups.
* Knowledge of foundational data domains, business processes, and enterprise applications is an asset.


We’re looking for a passionate individual who is interested in moving the dial and making a difference. We are an environment that looks to attract hardworking and committed people; people who want to challenge themselves and grow with a globally recognized brand that continues to change the world. If this describes you, consider joining our team. We look forward to reviewing your application.

jobs.title: Director, PathWise Actuarial Implementation and AI-Enabled Process Transformation
jobs.description:
Posting Description:
**Director, PathWise Actuarial Implementation and AI\-Enabled Process Transformation**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


The Life Solutions division at Aon is seeking a Director to lead large\-scale PathWise implementation projects. This role also supports AI\-enabled process transformation initiatives for life and annuity insurers across North America. This client\-facing role combines actuarial expertise, implementation leadership, and technology\-enabled transformation to help insurers modernize modelling, reporting, workflow automation, AI\-enabled systems, and operational workflows.  

The Director will work within Aon Life Solutions, part of Aon’s Reinsurance Strategy and Technology Group to translate business needs into practical implementation plans, scalable operating models, and measurable delivery outcomes. This role will be based in Canada. **Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada. This role is not eligible for sponsorship, and we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa or work permit.****Aon is in the business of better decisions**
----------------------------------------------


At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.
As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.**What the day will look like**
-------------------------------

**Implementation and Client Delivery*** Lead and support large\-scale PathWise implementation projects for life and annuity insurers across North America.
* Handle key implementation workstreams, including model migration, data integration, testing, reconciliation, workflow design, documentation, training, and production deployment.
* Translate client business objectives and current\-state processes into clear delivery plans, target\-state solutions, and implementation roadmaps.
* Develop and migrate actuarial models and production processes for valuation, pricing, financial reporting, capital, ALM, and risk management use cases.
* Support delivery governance, issue resolution, risk management, collaborator communication, post\-implementation stabilization, and client knowledge transfer.

**AI\-Enabled Process Transformation and Innovation**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Identify, prioritize, and continuously refine opportunities to use automation and AI\-enabled capabilities to improve actuarial modelling, reporting, reconciliation, documentation, and analysis processes across the PathWise lifecycle.
* Collaborate closely with the PathWise AI and development teams to translate business difficulties into clear AI use cases, feature requests, and improvements.
* Help clients redesign legacy actuarial workflows into more efficient, scalable, governed, and technology\-enabled operating models.
* Contribute to reusable implementation assets, process transformation playbooks, documentation templates, workflow designs, and AI\-enabled delivery accelerators.
* Lead or support pilots of new PathWise AI features, capturing user feedback and performance metrics, and consolidating insights into actionable recommendations for the PathWise AI roadmap
* Promote responsible and controlled use of AI\-enabled capabilities, including review, validation, traceability, documentation, and governance, and contribute to standard guidance on AI\-enabled workflows

**Business Development and Market Support**
-------------------------------------------

* Support PathWise growth in the North American life and annuity market through client solutioning, demonstrations (including AI\-enabled capabilities), proposals, implementation estimates, and project planning.
* Partner with senior leaders in client discussions on actuarial modernization, implementation strategy, process automation, AI\-enabled transformation, and business value.
* Develop proof\-of\-concept materials and presentations on PathWise capabilities, implementation guidelines, and emerging insurance industry issues.
* Develop and share case studies, training materials, and thought leadership that showcase successful AI\-enabled PathWise use cases and evolving capabilities

**How this opportunity is different**
-------------------------------------


PathWise is Aon’s high\-performance actuarial software platform, enabling insurers to model liabilities, assets, capital, and related business processes with speed, transparency, flexibility, and control. The platform supports modern actuarial modelling, scenario analysis, financial reporting, ALM, risk management, and enterprise\-scale production processes.
In this role, you will help clients migrate models and processes into PathWise, improve actuarial production workflows, and apply automation and AI\-enabled capabilities across requirements, model development, testing, reconciliation, documentation, workflow monitoring, and reporting. You will also help identify new AI applications within PathWise, develop improvements with the PathWise AI team, and promote adoption of emerging capabilities across client and internal teams.**Skills and experience that will lead to success**
---------------------------------------------------

* 10\+ years of experience in life insurance, life reinsurance, actuarial consulting, financial technology, actuarial modelling, or enterprise platform implementation.
* Experience with valuation, pricing, ALM, hedging, capital, financial reporting, risk management, model governance, or related actuarial functions.
* Experience supporting or leading implementation, modernization, migration, or transformation projects within actuarial, finance, risk, or insurance technology environments.
* Solid understanding of life and annuity products, reserves, capital, financial reporting, ALM, and risk management.
* Practical experience with actuarial mode

**Position Title:** Director, Education Design \& Intelligence


**Employment Type:** Full\-Time Staff \| Non\-Union


**Annual Salary Range:** $120,000 \- $130,000


**Division:** Education


**Reports To:** Vice President, Education


**Location:** 2180 Yonge Street, Toronto, ON

  


TVO Media Education Group (TVO (http://TVO.me)) is devoted to inspiring learning that changes lives and enriches communities. We are an internationally recognized digital learning organization that strives to engage, inform, and educate Ontarians of all ages.


**Who we are**



We are an agency of the Ontario Ministry of Education and a registered charity that contributes to learning, civic engagement, and public service media across Ontario. We provide free, trusted, and accessible educational content that can support Ontarians of all ages, regardless of background, location, or circumstance. To fulfill our mandate, TVO delivers curriculum\-connected resources through TVO Learn and TVOkids, offers Ontario’s largest online high school through TVO ILC, and produces journalism, documentaries, current affairs programming, and podcasts with TVO Today that help Ontarians understand the issues shaping their communities.


**What we’re looking for**



TVO’s purpose is to inspire learning that changes lives and enriches communities. Our mission is to create engaging learning experiences for all through quality content, services, and technology. To realize our vision of becoming a globally recognized digital learning organization, we must continually reimagine how learning experiences are designed and delivered.



Artificial intelligence is reshaping education, from assessment and academic integrity to learner pathways, instructional practice, and support. These changes create extraordinary opportunities while raising important questions about equity, accessibility, ethics, and educational quality. TVO has an opportunity to help lead this transformation.



The Director, Education Design \& Intelligence will shape how TVO responds. Working across TVOkids, TVO Learn, Mathify, TVO ILC, and emerging lifelong learning initiatives, this leader will guide TVO Education’s approach to AI, advance future\-focused learning design, build staff capability, and ensure our learning experiences remain relevant, inclusive, and impactful. This is the opportunity to help TVO Education design what learning becomes next.


**The Role**



Reporting to the Vice President, Education, the Director, Education Design \& Intelligence leads TVO’s Learning Experience Design and Production functions, with direct accountability for the Manager, Learning Experience Design and the Production Manager.



The Director works in close partnership with the Director, Curriculum \& Course Production, Director, Content Engagement, and Director, Academic Services. Together, the Directors bring complementary expertise to the design and delivery of TVO’s education portfolio. The Director, Education Design \& Intelligence contributes specialized leadership in learning design, AI integration, emerging technology, professional learning, and production.



Operating at the intersection of learning science, educational design, artificial intelligence, and digital innovation, the Director translates emerging developments into practical strategies, standards, and learning experiences that strengthen learner outcomes and organizational capability.


**How you will make an impact**


**Learning Design, Pathways \& Assessment**


* Lead the human\-centred design and continuous improvement of learning experiences across TVO’s education portfolio, ensuring they are inclusive, accessible, pedagogically grounded, and responsive to changing learner needs.
* Establish and maintain shared learning design principles, standards, and frameworks that guide how educational experiences are conceived, developed, evaluated, and improved across programs and platforms.
* Work in close partnership with the Director, Curriculum \& Course Production, Director, Content Engagement, and Director, Academic Services to strengthen learner journeys, pathways, engagement, and educational outcomes.
* Lead the continuous review and modernization of assessment and evaluation practices across TVO Education, responding to developments in AI, academic integrity, learner evidence, and emerging approaches to teaching and learning.
* Establish processes for regularly evaluating learning design standards, assessment approaches, and learner journeys, using research, learner feedback, outcomes data, prototyping, and testing to guide continuous improvement.
* Examine how AI and emerging technologies are reshaping curriculum, instruction, assessment, learner supports, credentialing, and progression, and translate those developments into practical opportunities for TVO.
* Embed collaborative design practices that centre diverse perspectives, lived experiences, accessibility, and learner needs.


**AI Strategy, Emerging Technology \& Professional Learning**


* Develop and lead TVO Education’s AI in Education strategy, guiding principles, and implementation roadmap.

Toronto, Ontario, Canada

37\.5

Data \& Analytics
**Pay Details:**

$155,000 \- $215,000 CAD
TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job\-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.


As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

The AVP, AI Product leads a material enterprise AI product area or AI transformation initiative within Layer 6\. This role is accountable for translating TD's AI priorities into trusted, scalable products and measurable outcomes \- from opportunity selection and AI product strategy through delivery, production, adoption, day 2 management and controlled retirement. They will lead a team of AI product owners and partners with multidisciplinary teams across business, design, technology, and risk to create AI powered experiences that are remarkably human and refreshingly simple.  



  

**Role Accountabilities:**

* **Set product direction:** Collaborate with business and technology partners to help shape the target state vision, develop AI roadmap, align on business outcomes and set investment priorities for the assigned AI product area or portfolio.
* **Select the right opportunities:** Assess client or colleague needs, strategic fit, AI suitability, feasibility, economics, risk and reuse potential; Surface and facilitate stop or pivot decisions as needed.
* **Own AI delivery end to end** . Lead discovery, design, build / blend, evaluation, control readiness, launch, adoption, production operation, scaling and retirement of AI capabilities.
* **Support realization of measurable value** . Set baselines and success measures; track adoption, financial and non\-financial benefits, product economics and sustained outcomes with business owners.
* **Apply technical product judgment** on model, data, retrieval, agentic design, evaluation, architecture, integration, human oversight, reliability, latency, scalability and cost decisions.
* **Embed Responsible AI and controls** . Ensure model risk, privacy, security, compliance, data governance, operational resilience and Responsible AI requirements are addressed through appropriate evidence, monitoring, escalation and remediation. Operate within TD risk appetite and governance.
* **Own production health** . Establish quality, service and risk thresholds; oversee monitoring, incidents, change, rollback, issue management and controlled decommissioning.
* **Scale through reuse** . Drive adoption of reusable capabilities, control artifacts, evaluation assets, reference patterns and playbooks to simplify delivery and reduce duplication.
* **Lead adoption and change** . Embed AI into business workflows, clarify accountable use, enable users, gather feedback and sustain client and colleague outcomes.
* **Build and lead a high performing team** . Hire, coach, develop and performance\-manage direct reports; build succession; align senior business, technology and control partners; remove barriers and raise product standards

jobs.title: Associate director, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.description:
Category: Finance
Location:
Mississauga, Ontario, CA  

**Your impact begins here**

  

As Associate Director, Financial Planning \& Analysis, you will head the Financial Planning \& Analysis team at Novo Canada. You will own the budgeting of ex\-factory sales and costs, manage operating profit and guide how resources are allocated, giving the President, CFO and Executive Team the clarity to decide and act. Your work helps the affiliate reach its financial and strategic goals and keeps our products available to the people who rely on them.

  

**What you’ll bring**

  

You combine strong financial expertise with the leadership to build a high\-performing team.

  

You will also bring:


* A bachelor/master’s degree in business administration, finance, business economics, accounting or auditing.
* At least 5 years of experience in finance, with proven success in numbers\-driven analysis, planning and reporting.
* Experience presenting to senior management and executives, and the ability to explain quantitative analysis clearly.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, and a track record of planning, prioritising and following through while proactively managing risks.
* A proven track record in complex, cross\-affiliate project management.
* An understanding of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and internal controls.
* Proficiency in SAP, Business Warehouse and Excel.
* In\-depth understanding of the global budgeting process at Novo or a company of similar size.
* A leadership style that builds trust, gives honest feedback, sets clear priorities and keeps things simple, especially through change.
  

**What you’ll do**

  

You will lead the full financial planning cycle for Novo Canada and the commercial terms that connect our products to customers.

  

Your work will help to:

  

* Lead, develop and plan the work of the Financial Planning \& Analysis team, including hiring, succession, individual development plans and performance dialogue, and manage the team budget.
* Oversee the affiliate P\&L, including ex\-factory sales, cost of goods sold and total operating costs, and own the total ex\-factory sales forecast and targets.
* Run the annual budget and rolling estimate processes, challenging submissions, ensuring compliance with corporate guidelines and anchoring approved targets across the business, while advising the President and CFO on resource allocation and supporting the Executive Team’s cost target.
* Deliver monthly and quarterly reporting to management, the region and headquarters on sales, expenses and operating profit, flagging issues early and proposing corrective actions.
* Own gross\-to\-net including rebate accruals under provincial Product Listing Agreements, and weekly sales performance reporting.
* Lead priority initiatives for Financial Planning \& Analysis and contribute to value\-creation projects across Executive Team areas, and work with other affiliates to share best practices and keep planning simple and value\-adding.
  

**Who you’ll work with**

  

You will join Finance \& Operations at Novo Canada as a member of the Finance \& Operations Leadership Team. You will lead the Financial Planning \& Analysis team, which you will help shape and grow.


Your closest partners will be the President, the CFO and the Executive Team. You will bring a financial perspective to the commercial teams, joining their management meetings, and support Line of Business colleagues with managing investments, month\-end closing and training on financial processes.


You will also work with regional finance, headquarters, the Pricing Committee and colleagues in other affiliates, and directly with buyers at key wholesalers. These relationships let you turn numbers into clear, timely decisions.

  

**What you can expect here**

  

* You will take on a leadership role where your voice shapes decisions at executive level. The role gives you a broad view of the business, from budgets and operating profit to trade strategy, pricing and launches, and the opportunity to build new skills through cross\-functional and cross\-affiliate work.
* You will be trusted to own your area and make decisions, with clear performance expectations and a culture that rewards results. You will also help your team thrive and grow through coaching, development plans and ongoing dialogue about performance and development.
  

**What we offer**

  

At Novo, you'll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

  

**Salary:** For this role the Annual Base Salary ranges from $159,230\.00 \- $209,230\.00


The placement in the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on your skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience match the position requirements

  

**Incentives:** Based on the role's level and other factors, the salary package may include short\-term (STI) and/or long\-term (LTI) incentives.

  

**Benefits:** The eligibility for specific benefits may vary based on the job and location


Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

  

**More information**

  

This job posting is for an existing vacancy

  

**Start now:** Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead financial planning and trade strategy that helps Novo Canada reach its goals, apply for the Associate Director, Financial Planning \& Analysis role by **16 October 2026**. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

  

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

The Director, Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) leads enterprise budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and decision support. This role partners with senior leadership and business units to align financial and operational realities, provide proactive insights, and drive performance. The Director manages a high\-performing FP\&A team and ensures disciplined governance, clear executive reporting, and continuous improvement, leveraging strong analytics and modeling.


**What we offer (and why you’ll love it here!):**


* **Epic Work\-Life Balance:** Flexible remote work options because we value your time and well\-being.
* **Growth Opportunities:** Committed to fostering a culture of growth, where every team member is encouraged to pursue new skills, expand their knowledge, and advance their careers.
* **Vibrant Culture:** Over 1,500 team members across Canada and year over year we manage to maintain an overall above industry engagement score by using a monthly pulse survey.
* **Attractive Compensation:** Competitive salary, incentive program, and comprehensive benefits package.
* **What \& Where**: Full\-Time, Permanent \& Moncton, NB or Oakville, ON


**Why BioScript Solutions?**



At BioScript, we're not just a company—we're a fast\-growing company always putting patients first. Recognized as one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies, we believe in pushing boundaries, setting trends, and creating meaningful experiences that captivate and inspire. Our vibrant team is made up of innovative minds who are passionate about driving success and making an impact. Ready to be a part of this exhilarating journey?


**Your Mission:** 

**Budgeting \& Forecasting**

* Lead the annual budgeting process and short and long\-term financial forecasting to support business strategy and advise senior leaders on financial implications of strategic choices.
* Coordinate cross\-functional inputs to ensure realistic plans, aligned assumptions, and accountability for outcomes.


 **Management Reporting \& Insights**

* Establish and monitor financial and operational KPIs, ensuring robust analytics to assess progress, profitability, and efficiency.
* Chair senior management meetings, coordinating the preparation, consolidation, and presentation of reporting packages, including financial results, KPIs, and related commentary.
* Oversee the provision of monthly results and interpretations to business units to support achievement of departmental goals.
* Develop, implement, monitor, and continually improve management reporting to keep pace with structural changes and growth.
* Leverage analytics and modeling to interpret results and articulate clear, actionable recommendations.
* Review performance versus plan/forecast, identify significant variances, and drive corrective actions.


**Business Partnering**

* Collaborate with senior management to ensure operational and financial realities are aligned.
* Challenge business units through proactive insights and the identification of opportunities to improve growth, margin, productivity, and cash performance.
* Support key business decisions and initiatives with data\-driven analysis and clear financial implications.


**Scenario \& Investment Analysis**

* Direct scenario and sensitivity analyses for strategic decisions, investments, and resource allocation.
* Evaluate trade\-offs and risk/return dynamics; synthesize recommendations for executive decision\-making.


**Governance \& Controls**

* Partner with Accounting to align on accounting policies, close calendars, and reconciliation of actuals to plans/forecasts.
* Maintain disciplined methodologies for budgeting, forecasting, KPI definitions, and variance analysis.


**Board \& Executive Reporting**

* Prepare executive and board\-level materials with clear insights, risks, opportunities, and recommendations.
* Craft concise narratives and visuals that translate complex financials into strategic implications for decision\-makers.
* Coordinate timelines and inputs to ensure accurate, timely delivery of all board/executive reporting packages.


**Leadership Responsibilities:**

* Provides clear direction, sets measurable goals, and holds team members accountable for performance and results.
* Coaches, develops, and supports team members through regular feedback, performance reviews, and career development planning.
* Fosters a high\-performing, inclusive team culture that aligns with company values and business objectives.


**What You Bring to the Table:**

**Education:**


* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance or related field.
* CPA designation required.


**Experience:**


* Minimum of 10 years’ financial and team management experience.


**Skills:**


* Strong business acumen with clear understanding of industry trends, able to think strategically.
* Advanced financial modeling, forecasting, and budgeting capabilities.
* Strong analytical mindset and communication skills; adept at presenting complex financial concepts to non\-financial stakeholders.
* Impeccable attention to detail.
* Extensive experience leading budgeting and forecasting for mid\-to\-large sized organizations.
* Strong background in management reporting, budgeting and analytics.
* Experience partnering with and influencing senior executives and divisional leaders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Works effectively in teams.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple deadlines and competing priorities.
* Results\-oriented and process\-driven.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* English proficiency is required for this position to effectively communicate with internal and external stakeholders.

new_jobs.description:

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Transformation Consulting Managing Director to join our team in Toronto, Ontario (CA\-ON), Canada (CA).
  
  

The Sr Infrastructure Transformation and Consulting Director will be responsible for designing, guiding, and overseeing NTT DATA North America’s overall technology infrastructure with a primary focus on Infrastructure Transformation. This role will align IT strategy with business goals by assessing current\-state environments, identifying modernization opportunities, and creating a blueprint for future technology development, including standards, policies, and architecture frameworks to support efficient, secure, scalable, and transformation\-ready operations across the enterprise; essentially acting as a bridge between business needs and technical implementation.
  
  

* This position is remote, however will require some travel to the client site.


**Key responsibilities:**  

**IT Strategic planning:**  

Develop and maintain the enterprise architecture roadmap, aligning IT strategy with business objectives for NTT DATA, Merger and Acquisition integrations, and enterprise\-wide Infrastructure Transformation initiatives.
  
  

**Architecture design:**  

Design and document the overall system architecture, including application, data, infrastructure, cloud, security, and transformation components to support modernization and scalable enterprise operations.
  
  

**Technology evaluation:**  

Research and evaluate new technologies, platforms, and infrastructure modernization approaches to identify opportunities for transformation, operational improvement, and long\-term scalability.
  
  

**Standards and governance:**  

Establish and enforce architectural standards, guidelines, and governance processes to ensure consistency and compliance
  
  

**Collaboration:**  

Work with various stakeholders including business leaders, global EAs, project teams, and technical teams to understand requirements and translate them into architectural solutions.
  
  

**Cost optimization:**  

Analyze and optimize IT spending by identifying potential cost savings through architectural improvements.
  
  

**Risk management:**  

Identify and mitigate potential risks associated with technology architecture.
  
  

**Communication and documentation:**  

Clearly communicate architectural concepts and decisions to technical and non\-technical audiences through documentation and presentations.
  
  

Basic Requirements
  
  

* 11\+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, infrastructure transformation, cloud computing, Generative AI, LLMs, databases, networking, security, and application development, with a deep understanding of how these technologies support business and modernization objectives.


Additional Preferences
  
  

**Leadership skills:**  

Minimum of 11\+ years of experience influencing and guiding cross\-functional teams toward implementing an enterprise architecture vision, with demonstrated ability to lead infrastructure transformation and modernization efforts.
  
  

**Business acumen:**  

Ability to understand business needs and translate them into technical requirements.
  
  

**Communication skills:**  

Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively collaborate with diverse stakeholders.
  
  

**Analytical skills:**  

Ability to analyze complex systems, identify potential issues, and propose solutions.
  
  

NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for Canada\-based positions. The starting pay range for this role is $187,192 \- $311,988 CAD. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications. This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation based on individual and/or company performance. If the position offered is temporary, the position will not be eligible for incentive compensation.
  
  

This position is eligible for the Company’s comprehensive benefits program in Canada, including customizable health and dental coverage with telemedicine, wellness credits, and gym discounts. Employees receive income protection through life, disability, and optional insurance plans, plus access to a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program. Additional perks include retirement savings, a remote work allowance for eligible employees, and various discounts and travel insurance.
  
  

About NTT DATA
  
  

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in\-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible
